bug_semantics: The standalone FastAPI key server wired POST /api/v1/keys (upload) and POST /api/v1/keys/{fingerprint}/revoke to Depends(verify_api_token). verify_api_token in server/key-server/app/api/v1/keys.py (lines 48-87) only required a non-empty Authorization: Bearer <string>; it never checked a JWT, HMAC, issued-token store, or any secret. Any caller sending Authorization: Bearer x was treated as authenticated and could upload arbitrary public-key bundles or revoke any stored key. GET /api/v1/keys/search was already public (no auth dependency), so listing/search did not itself need the bypass. CWE-287.
flaw_origin: The stub was the original production implementation, not a later regression. fafdfeed1b279cfe61e86cd8adc132b206eef8d4 first added server/key-server/app/api/v1/keys.py with comments 'In production, validate token against database or JWT' / 'For now, simple token check (replace with proper validation)' and then returned True. That placeholder remained the live FastAPI auth dependency until the HMAC fix.
